name: Kitao Sekka
source:
"I am bound by this figure... I have been wearing it when I was dead, in summer clothes"

A ghost girl, which can be often seen at the school rooftop. Doesn't have any friends and seems to be very lonely. Shuuya tries to befriend her to make her more comfortable around others.
